english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for miscellaneous unwanted physical things, especially household clutter.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for miscellaneous collectible throwaway objects, including packaging and cheap publications.
Use this for miscellaneous objects cluttering a room or space, especially when the objects rather than the disorder are the focus.

examples.english: The room at home is piled up with junk.

examples.english: While moving, I found a box of old ephemera, including concert programmes and packaging.
